[[Image:Deathwatch Guard.jpg|right|thumb|150px|Deathwatch Guard portrait done by Seamas Gallagher]]
The '''Deathwatch Guard''' are elite [[Seanchan]] personal guards to the Seanchan Empress. They are made up of both men and [[Ogier]] [[Gardener]]s. The humans are ''[[da'covale]]'' and are the private property of the Empress. If the person the Deathwatch Guard is protecting dies, the remaining human guards are executed.

Their armor is lacquered red and green, the latter so dark that it is commonly thought of as black. Ranks in the Deathwatch stand a half step above those in the [[Ever Victorious Army]].{{ref/book|11|34}}

Members of the Deathwatch Guard often display the ravens tattooed on their shoulders, the mark of a ''da'covale'' of the Empress.{{ref/book|8|Glossary}}



== Known members of the Deathwatch ==
* [[Furyk Karede]] - Commander of the Deathwatch in the Westlands
* [[Musenge]] - [[Captain]]
* [[Hartha]] - [[First Gardener]], commanding the Ogier Deathwatch
